title.narrative: 'Housing for internally displaced persons (IDPs) and rehabilitation of liberated cities in Ukraine'

description.narrative: The main purpose of the action is to provide capacity to municipalities including liberated cities for activities to strengthen economic resilience and help the Ukrainian population, including Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) to quickly recover from the damages from the armed conflict and to build back public infrastructure (construction of new housing for IDPs and social infrastructure rehabilitation, such as schools, kindergartens, hospitals).
